description: This file defines functions and data structures for handling hexadecimal conversions, including a lookup table, inline functions for value extraction and conversion, and a prototype for converting hex strings to byte arrays.

methods.name: unsigned int hexval(unsigned char c)
methods.description: Inline function that returns the hexadecimal value of a given character using a lookup table.

methods.name: int hex2chr(const char * s)
methods.description: Converts two hexadecimal digits into a character byte, returning a negative value on error.

methods.name: hex_to_bytes
methods.description: Converts a string of hexadecimal characters into its binary representation, returning 0 on success or -1 on failure.

ctags.name: hexval
ctags.pattern: /^static inline unsigned int hexval(unsigned char c)$/
